rationale: Exact positive Count/count results in explicit field biological Population Census or Species Density context support historical sampled occurrence. Organization+site Station join supplies official countyFIPS; coarse cartographic geometry is only a contradiction diagnostic. Two independent state reviews reconstruct52supported pair witnesses with a Russell method hold. MAIN additionally reviewed the four candidate Estimated/Calculated rows: NJDEP D-frame-net benthic collection with APHA10500-C sample processing, and TDEC qualitative-sediment dip-net field samples. Positive values remain their original type and do not support reconstructed abundance. NARS ZOO:ZOFN records remain outside this v1 method pending specific count reconciliation. The preflight acquisition was exploratory; the registered adapter replays retained source bytes with exact independent acquisition recipe provenance and no claimed new provider retrieval. National offline review found the same unreviewed fine-zooplankton pathway in three additional pairs: Indiana18149, NewYork36123 and Oklahoma40011. All four pairs remain unchanged;138pairs in20states have supported witnesses.
attribution: National Water Quality Monitoring Council (2026), Water Quality Portal, accessed 2026-09-08, https://doi.org/10.5066/P9QRKUVJ. Exact queries are linked from the source record. CEDEN: California Environmental Data Exchange Network, State Water Resources Control Board, accessed 2026-09-08, https://ceden.waterboards.ca.gov/.
limitations: Historical sampled occurrence only; current persistence, establishment, countywide prevalence and protocol completion are not established.
The WQX 2.2 profile excludes USGS data added after March 11,2024; complete query response counts are not a complete current national inventory.
Zero, blank, negative, provisional, quality-control, toxicity, unidentified and method-held rows create no absence or non-detection claim.
Organization/activity/site identities and anonymous raw result locators are preserved. Identical disclosed fields need not identify the same specimen; repeated rows are never summed into progress.

County assignment follows unambiguous official Station metadata. Coarse generalized map boundaries may omit open water or differ at river borders; explicit source county is not replaced by an approximate map.
Public source facts are reproduced with agency and WQP attribution; no blanketCC0 license or provider endorsement is claimed.
